reviews.review:
While this game isn't very fast (Its pace is more in line with Team Fortress 2), It is incredibly fun and very twitch-shooty which I greatly enjoy

Unlike gunfire reborn, The devs at least make an attempt to have the movement be deep (Though they do fall short in certain areas of movement like the Air Strafing and Slide-Hopping feeling off) 

This game could use tighter air strafing and better Slide-Hop controls that allow for proper slide hopping like in Titanfall 2 or Apex Legends, And also the use of stun mechanics is questonable 

Otherwise, This game is addictive. 
Picking up the sniper rifle and quick scoping enemies back to back is incredibly fun but so is running in with a shotgun and blasting everything in the face, This game supports countless skill levels and play styles along with a pretty fun Co-Op mode and non-linier progression 

If you want a good medium to fast paced looter shooter, Throw away Destiny and pick up Roboquest

This game is incredible and an absolute must have.
You have classes with abilities and a passive, for your prefered playstyle, although i feel like its missing a "heavy" guy and a dedicated Sniper. 
The ones currently in go somewhat in that direction, but their abilities arent really supporting that well.

What it lacks is an endless mode, but i heard there might be something coming with the next update.
It also lacks the challenge that games like Crab Champions provide with additional challenge modifications that alternate stuff, give boosts to enemies or mix rules around.

Progression is also a bit thin or generic. 
5% more health per level up here, a better weapon drop from chests there.
Would love to buy something more for my currencies.

But it has:
Coop
Itemization
Random Loot
A lot of ways to become stronger.
A lot of choices
A lot of weapons
A lot of levels and unlocks/quests
5 Difficulties
Good graphics
Runs well
Controls very fluid
Nice (gun)sound
THE SOUNDTRACK FREAKING SLAPS


[b]To the negatives:[/b]
- There are no alternative modes to motivate you to play more. No Endless Mode, No New Game Plus. Thus replayability is a big issue.

- A limited amount of difficulties to choose from. 
I personally would prefer some sort of Endless Run mode with ramping up difficulty or Mutators/Challenge Modifications as in Crab Champions that go beyond the difficulty i selected.

- Its an Arena Shooter with linear levels mostly. Would have loved to see more open spaces especially for coop and drastically larger or longer ones. The later city level is a good direction, but actually becomes annoying due to its structure.

- Enemies are generic and boring. 
I mean, their attacks are fine and provide enough variation to not get bored in terms of combat. 
But their visual design is the most boring in ages.
They are grey metal robots with red eyes. Super lame. 
I mean, look at the screenshots and you see 100% of what to expect when it comes to the enemies.
There is no interesting visual design. They dont look cool or exceptional. They look like placeholders.
They could be super cool, simply by being not grey. But here we are, generic enemy design 101.
Positive: The bosses absolutely show how this can be done.

[b]Summary[/b]

If you ask whether its worth to get, i would say "yes, absolutely".
Its a fun shooter, great to play, a real gem and easily is up on top there with Risk of Rain 2 and Crab Champions.
If you wanted a fun looter shooter with rogue-like skilling, i would say get those three and you are good to go for the next weeks.

If Endless Mode kicks in, its perfect.
